integrity: All-order proof from incidence axioms; independently replayable finite order-three enumeration and order-three/four structural tests.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for every existing finite affine plane of order at least three; it excludes the binary plane, and does not address nonoptimal packing colourings or automorphism-orbit counts. Two finite scripts corroborate rather than prove the infinite family. Historical priority remains subject to unindexed sources.
title: Parallel-class rigidity and the exact packing-colouring census of finite affine-plane incidence graphs
